morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，现代马来语中作为完整词根记忆；可读作 [ˈkwa.ri]。派生 menguari 时，meN- 在 k 前变为 meng-，词首 k 脱落。

senses.zh_definition: 采石场；通过钻孔、爆破或挖掘等方式取得石料及相关建筑材料的场地。
senses.en_definition: A site where stone or other construction materials are extracted by excavation, drilling, or blasting.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat batu atau bahan binaan seumpamanya diperoleh melalui penggalian, penggerudian, peletupan dan kaedah lain.
senses.nuances: 主要指开采场地，而非开采出来的石块。kuari pasir 指采砂场。与 lombong 的区别须结合材料和开采方式判断，不能简单理解为所有露天矿都叫 kuari。本条对应数据包的采石场义；DBP 另收文莱地区 kuari pintu 的同形异义用法。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kuari)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengusaha kuari itu diarahkan mengawal pelepasan habuk bagi mengurangkan gangguan kepada penduduk berhampiran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该采石场经营者受命控制粉尘排放，以减少对附近居民的影响。
dual_scenarios.en: The quarry operator was directed to control dust emissions to reduce disturbance to nearby residents.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Banyak lori keluar masuk kat kuari tu pagi ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Banyak lori keluar masuk di kuari itu pada pagi ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 今天早上好多罗里进出那个采石场。
dual_scenarios.en: There are loads of trucks going in and out of that quarry this morning.

etymology.historical_story: Kuari was borrowed from English quarry, retaining the meaning of a place where stone is extracted. Its Malay spelling makes the borrowed sound recognizable through local spelling conventions. The word also participates in Malay grammar: menguari means to quarry, showing how an imported industrial noun can become the base of a locally formed verb. [Etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/kuari), [DBP derivation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kuari)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kuari 和英语 quarry 声音相近：想象一辆辆运石罗里从 kuari 开出来。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性的行业及地理用词，新闻、工作报告和日常交流均适用；称呼相关人员可用 pekerja kuari 或 pengusaha kuari。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论噪音、粉尘及社区影响时，应具体说明问题，避免把 kuari 本身当作‘非法开采’的同义词。合法性需另用 berlesen 或 tanpa lesen 等表达。
